content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is a wall of text with three call actions (header Pokličite, Pokličite me, Pišite mi) and no visual anchor; the footer wordmark 'Inštrukcije Pia' is oversized and repeats the name three times in a row.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero leaves the whole left half under the headline empty and then runs into a pricing section with a dead band, while the footer wordmark is grotesquely large and clipped against the footer contents.","phone":{"impression":2,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":2},"desktop":{"impression":2,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":2},"fixes":["Add a portrait of Pia or a desk/notebook photo beside the hero text on desktop and under the headline on phone, so the empty left half and text wall get a visual anchor.","Reduce the giant footer wordmark to a normal size and merge the 'Inštrukcije Pia' name, address and contacts into one compact block instead of repeating the name three times.","Keep one primary action per screen: drop 'Pokličite me' in the hero (header/fixed bar already calls) and make 'Pišite mi' a proper button; tighten the dead bands after pricing and after the about section."],"blockers":["Desktop footer: the oversized 'Inštrukcije Pia' wordmark is cut off at the slice edge and its descender overlaps the contact row.","Phone and desktop footer: the business name is repeated three times in succession (wordmark, bold name, Naziv line)."]}
